monsters.name: Briar sprite
monsters.text: A knee-high thing of twigs and spite, giggling through a mouth full of thorns.

monsters.name: Gloamwolf
monsters.text: A wolf as dark as the space between trees, with eyes that give off a little cold light.

monsters.name: Dusk stag
monsters.text: A great black stag whose antlers hold small lights, like a tree full of fireflies. It does not like being followed.

monsters.name: Mirror wraith
monsters.text: Something climbs out of the pool wearing a sloppy copy of your face. It smiles too wide.

monsters.name: Moth sentinel
monsters.text: A slender fey guard in a cuirass of grey chitin, with pale wings folded behind its shoulders and a spear of black glass.

monsters.name: The Briar Warden
monsters.text: A hunched shape of knotted briar with a stag's skull for a head. Dangling from its horn, on a silk cord, is a small lantern still burning.

on_defeat.message: The Warden folds into a heap of dead thorns. The lantern swings free, its little moth still alight.

monsters.name: Sir Gossamer, champion of the Court
monsters.text: A tall fey knight with moth-wing pauldrons and a rapier like a splinter of night. He fights the way he bows: perfectly.

on_defeat.message: Sir Gossamer lowers his blade and, with a courtier's grace, hands you the shard. 'A bargain broken is a bargain remembered, mortal. The Wood will remember.'
